name: San Mateo Adult & Career Education
description: Free ESL and adult education classes in San Mateo County
fullDescription: San Mateo Adult & Career Education (SMACE) offers free and low-cost classes for adults including ESL, GED and high school diploma, citizenship, and career training.
whatTheyOffer:
- English (ESL) classes, including ESL citizenship preparation
- Self-paced GED and high school diploma classes
- Career technical education in high-demand fields (such as pharmacy technician), including EDD-approved courses
- Active adult and older adult classes (such as free AI basics workshops for adults 55+)
- Career services and job search tools
howToGetIt:
1. Browse the course catalog on the SMACE website
2. Enroll online or visit the campus at 789 East Poplar Ave
3. Take placement test for ESL if needed
4. Enroll in classes
address: 789 East Poplar Ave, San Mateo, CA 94401
keywords: adult school, San Mateo, SMACE, GED, ESL, high school diploma, adult education, career training, free classes, Peninsula, citizenship
